selected_evidence.summary: The directory reports root:root ownership and mode 1777 (drwxrwxrwt); two unprivileged users wrote files, and cross-user deletion was denied. Final verification confirms the requested mode remains and test artifacts are gone.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the recovered boot ID changed to 9ed4f079-9ba6-427d-ad18-7fe13df89dae; post-restart checks confirmed mode 1777, persisted test data, successful unprivileged writes, and continued sticky-bit protection.

commands.command:
id; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; if [ -e /srv/drop ]; then stat -c 'path=%n type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a perms=%A' /srv/drop; else printf 'path=/srv/drop state=absent
'; fi
install -d -o root -g root -m 1777 /srv/drop && if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then restorecon /srv/drop; fi; stat -c 'path=%n type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a perms=%A' /srv/drop
commands.stdout: path=/srv/drop type=directory owner=root group=root mode=1777 perms=drwxrwxrwt

commands.command: getent passwd nobody daemon; command -v runuser || command -v setpriv

rm -f /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon; runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'printf "%s
" nobody-data > /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody'; runuser -u daemon -- sh -c 'printf "%s
" daemon-data > /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon'; printf '%s
' 'created-files:'; stat -c '%n owner=%U mode=%a' /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon; runuser -u daemon -- rm /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody >/tmp/sticky-cross-delete.out 2>&1; cross_status=$?; printf 'daemon_delete_nobody_status=%s
' "$cross_status"; cat /tmp/sticky-cross-delete.out; if [ "$cross_status" -ne 0 ] && [ -f /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody ]; then printf '%s
' 'sticky_protection=PASS'; else printf '%s
' 'sticky_protection=FAIL'; exit 1; fi
